scenes.say: Twelfth in the final race, and he's still the NASCAR champion. For the third time.
Kyle Larson won it two years in a row. NASCAR hadn't seen that since Jimmie Johnson in twenty ten.
That's three titles. Only Petty, Earnhardt, Johnson and Gordon have more.
He arrived at Homestead sixty-seven points clear, and the first stage was enough to seal it.
In the ten-race Chase he won three times and finished in the top ten eight times.
He's thirty-four. For Hendrick Motorsports it's a sixteenth Cup title.
NASCAR calendar and standings are on LapRadar.

title: Kyle Larson: a third NASCAR title and the first repeat since 2010
